description: JWT signing keys generated as 1024-bit RSA — in Node with crypto.generateKeyPairSync('rsa', { modulusLength: 1024 }) and in Python with cryptography's rsa.generate_private_key(key_size=1024), the standard key-generation call in each ecosystem. A 1024-bit modulus is within reach of well-funded attackers, so tokens can be forged. VC123 must fire on both.
